HexKagune 6.0.6 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server.

**Fixed in 6.0.6**
- As a ghoul you can no longer eat normal food. Only raw flesh (and tolerated drinks) can be eaten. Trying to eat anything else does nothing and tells you so.
- AppleSkin's yellow hunger and saturation icons no longer draw over the flesh reserve bar.
- 6.0.6 works with any 6.0 server and players.
